nodes.title: Create and deliberately reassign per-chat homes

body:
## Parent

[#37 — Spec: One-window IDE with project tabs and shared Agents](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/37)

## What to build

Discovery waits for metadata, preserves recorded homes and offers non-blocking Choose Project for ambiguity. Assignment keeps the existing conversation and survives weaker later metadata.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Expose connected providers' existing history normally despite fresh app-owned state, without importing another editor's chat database.
- [x] Preserve recorded homes and intentional No Workspace; wait while required metadata is loading instead of treating incomplete metadata as a settled home.
- [x] Automatic association requires one exact home; folder containment, repository similarity and session membership cannot justify assignment.
- [ ] Missing or ambiguous ownership leaves the conversation accessible in Agents and offers non-blocking Choose Project when opened or project navigation is requested; do not introduce a startup bulk wizard.
- [ ] Choosing a home associates the existing conversation without copying, sending or claiming execution, and weaker later discovery cannot overwrite the explicit choice.
- [x] Test loading-to-resolved, ambiguous, explicit-assignment and later-weaker-metadata flows through the existing provider-neutral service/presentation boundary; keep unavailable provider access recorded as unperformed.

## Execution boundary

This is an approved implementation slice within [#34](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/34). Inspect and reuse its published disposable baseline; implement only missing behaviour using existing services and test infrastructure. Preserve the full accepted contract in #37 and its authoritative linked resolutions, including requirements not repeated here.

Use a named bounded scenario, isolated app-owned state and scratch workspaces. Record exact source/build, focused checks, failures/repairs and unperformed coverage. [#35](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/issues/35) retains the full staged runtime acceptance gate and separate creator verdict. Provider work/sign-in remains deferred and authorization probes remain paused. Publication does not start execution, lift those limits, establish feasibility or authorize a production merge.

comments.body:
Partial implementation checkpoint — leave this issue open.

Conservative exact-home discovery, loading-aware non-blocking Choose Project and durable assignment/cache preservation are integrated (`96d580b780c`, merge `546c7fe98a5`). 974 focused tests passed with13 existing pending; build/typecheck/lint passed. These are provider-neutral service/presentation checks, not actual native/provider runtime.

Unchecked criteria1,4–5: extension-backed durable assignment remains unsupported, real connected-provider history/native Choose Project validation unperformed, and a P2 source defect prevents reoffering Choose Project for the same chat after notification dismissal or picker cancellation. Deduplicate only while a usable offer is pending; no repair was started. Known-home routing remains #52.

Open native blockers: #50. Checked criteria describe only established source/service or explicitly recorded runtime behavior; unchecked compound criteria remain incomplete. A merge or unit pass is not full runtime acceptance.

Checkpoint source `403375db5f1794d95849d795ceecbf8553d2dfdb`; integration branch `integration/spec-37-complete`; draft [PR #60](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/pull/60). [Committed handoffs, evidence and review](https://github.com/ejjsharpe/escode/blob/d71ae1f23b018cfc7f99616d24f187dc96375ea6/prototypes/live-hosting/spec-37/checkpoint-2026-10-28/README.md). Orchestration is stopped; no worker remains assigned. Provider work/sign-in stays deferred, authorization probes stay paused, no production merge is authorized, and #35 retains full staged acceptance plus the separate creator verdict.
